P01.rationale: A large portrait of a person occupies roughly half the left column and dominates the upper-left quadrant, serving as a strong human anchor, though it is a client rather than a founder figure.

P05.rationale: The client portrait is clearly framed and named ('Cordes Consulting / David Cordes') at meaningful size, filling a substantial portion of the left column, though no separate named portrait appears in the right column.

P07.rationale: No press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is visible beyond a single blurred quote block, which lacks the structural social-proof device.

P10.rationale: Oversized decorative numerals ('2', '3') are overlaid on the portrait image, and large stat numerals ('50 %', '6', '0') function as decorative typographic anchors on the right column.

P11.rationale: Three concrete KPI metrics (50%, 6 processes, 0 migrations) are displayed as large numbered stats with descriptive labels, providing real data bound to outcomes, though no chart or before/after visualisation is present.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably dense with a portrait, structured text sections, stat blocks, and a quote, giving a magazine-editorial feel, though the right column has some under-filled vertical space.

P13.rationale: The background is a warm off-white/cream tone that provides a subtle atmospheric quality, but there is no distinct texture or atmospheric treatment beyond a flat tinted field.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo has a natural dark background that keeps the overlaid decorative numerals readable, though no explicit scrim or darkening treatment is applied.

P16.rationale: No device mockup (phone, laptop, or book) is present anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a specific individual (named CEO) in a professional setting, lending some specificity, though the background is generic enough to read as semi-stock.

N08.rationale: The right column has noticeable vertical gaps between the stat items and the blurred quote block, creating some dead whitespace, but it is not severely empty overall.

N10.rationale: The decorative numerals sit directly on the portrait photo without a scrim, but the dark background of the photo provides sufficient contrast so readability is not severely compromised.
